description: This file is a Java interface defining the service for managing ProductAttribute entities, including methods for saving, updating, and retrieving product attributes based on various identifiers.

classes.name: ProductAttributeService
classes.description: Java interface for handling product attribute related operations, extending generic entity service with methods specific to product attributes.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProductAttribute object, throwing ServiceException if an error occurs.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific MerchantStore and option ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific MerchantStore and option value ID.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific MerchantStore, Product, and Language.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttributes based on a list of attribute IDs within a MerchantStore.
